description: Use when you will call the data routes often for up to thirty days. For seven days use buy_week_pass; for a single call, call the data tool directly. Check a key's expiry with check_pass. A thirty-day fair-use access pass: returns a news402 pass key and expiry for the eight data routes. Send the pass key as a Bearer token. Fair use applies. Call without payment to see the offer; pay to get the news402 pass key. No parameters. Costs $9 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.
name: buy_month_pass
title: Pay: Thirty-day access pass
